settings.title: Track Order
settings.subtitle: Follow your IYOVA order from our warehouse to your door.

settings.content:
Once your order has shipped, you'll receive an email with a tracking number and link to follow your delivery in real time.

Can't find your tracking email?

Check your spam folder, or log in to your account to view order status. If you checked out as a guest, use the link in your order confirmation email.

Still need help?

Contact our customer care team with your order number and we'll provide an update within one business day.
settings.sidebar_text: Processing: 1–2 business days. Shipped: tracking link sent by email. Delivered: enjoy your new ritual.
